item.title: Clip resurfaces of Talarico calling parents 'abusive' over gender identity
item.description: James Talarico, a Democratic Texas Senate candidate, previously described parents' refusal to acknowledge a child's gender identity as "abusive" behavior.

item.title: Trump says China 'spies' on US after report links Chinese imagery to Iran strike
item.description: The president said the U.S. also spies on China after a report connected Chinese satellite imagery to Iran's deadly July missile attack on American troops.
